notes: Resident population from Iran's 2016 census by official municipal district (mantaqeh) — genuine intra-city subdivisions (Tehran's own 22 city districts, plus Karaj's districts and two satellite towns merged in when Karaj was folded into this map for its shared metro corridor). No real employment data exists: jobs are a flat 40% of resident population, redistributed across OSM buildings weighted by floor area only, using OSM commercial/office POI density as the spatial signal for where those jobs concentrate. Commute flows are an unconstrained gravity model (distance-decay, 3km minimum trip distance) — no real O/D data of any kind anchors the flow directions or volumes.
sources: amar.org.ir (Statistical Center of Iran) — "ویژگی‌های جمعیتی، اجتماعی و اقتصادی مناطق ۲۲‌گانه تهران در سرشماری‌های سال‌های ۱۳۹۰ و ۱۳۹۵" (demographic/social/economic characteristics of Tehran's 22 mantaqeh, 2011 and 2016 censuses): amar.org.ir/news/ID/5053/
